_meta.source: July 2026 masterplan (jeffrey mak: architect ltd) and the Aug 25, 2026 plan stats workbook, via the Apple Blossom Commons research project
_meta.note: All figures are planning concepts. 'publicFacts' may be shown on the site; 'internalNotes' must never be rendered. Keys match data/district-geometry-v1.json.

districts.name: Chelan Wine Village
districts.summary: The central village: wineries and breweries, restaurants, boutique retail and gathering spaces along Vintner's Walk.
publicFacts: The Barrel House, Tasting Courtyard, Market Hall
districts.internalNotes: Includes the top block near Discovery Commons, the main village and the diagonal Retail High Street spine.

districts.name: Wellness District
districts.summary: Medical uses around the Lake Chelan Health Hospital campus, with clinics and rehabilitation close to the senior homes.
districts.internalNotes: Presented as part of Apple Blossom Commons. The hospital belongs to Lake Chelan Health; do not call them a partner until they agree to be named.

districts.name: Orchard Grove
districts.summary: 55+ cottage homes, townhomes and apartments designed for owners who want to age in place.
publicFacts: Recreation center with gardens and track

districts.name: Heritage Grove
districts.summary: Homes for seniors who prefer or require assistance, from independent living to memory care.
districts.internalNotes: ~419 units or beds is unresolved (units vs beds). Do not publish a count.

districts.name: Apple Blossom Residence
districts.summary: Market-rate apartments, townhomes and detached homes, buffered from Chelan Falls Road and Apple Blossom Drive.
districts.internalNotes: Not senior housing. A 75,000 sf building on the PDF is missing from the workbook; totals range 126–332 units. Do not publish a total.

districts.name: Harvest Crossing
districts.summary: Workforce homes close to the village's shops and services, with a live-work zone.
districts.internalNotes: 200 apartments approved by the owner for public use on Oct 16, 2026; revise if it changes.

districts.name: Summit Recreation Park
districts.summary: Sports fields, a seasonal roller and ice rink, a playground and a pond, in two parts north and south.
districts.internalNotes: Two separate parts; the geometry has two label positions.

districts.name: Discovery Commons
districts.summary: An aspiration for lifelong learning: a potential K-12 school, community center and library.

districts.name: Orchard Preserve
districts.summary: Open space with trails and a scenic overlook at the highest point of the site.

districts.name: Grand Orchard Hotel
districts.summary: A cottage-style hotel with event space at the edge of the village.
districts.internalNotes: Key count unresolved: masterplan text says 65 units, stats say 115 keys. Do not publish a key count.
